hook_line: RAMAYANA OPENS WITH BOLLYWOOD'S SECOND-BEST ADVANCE EVER

hook_stat.sub: Day 1 advance sales in India excluding blocked seats

stats.label: Tickets sold before the first show
Shows across India — highest ever for a Bollywood film
Dhurandhar 2 — the only film ahead in Day 1 pre-sales

diaspora_bullets: International pre-sales had crossed Rs 111 crore a day before release
Released in Hindi, Kannada, Telugu, Tamil and Malayalam versions
news_summary: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi, closed its day 1 advance booking at Rs 42.96 crore gross in India excluding blocked seats, from 12.14 lakh tickets.
payoff: It is the highest pre-sales ever for a non-sequel.
